description: Anniversary Summit Register Now Ontario Nature Annual Gathering 2024 © Jenna Quinn 95th Anniversary Summit Ontario Nature’s Anniversary Summit will be held in Kingston on Saturday, June 13, 2026 from 8am to 5pm. The day’s activities will include hands-on workshops, thought-provoking presentations, guided field trips and our 95th Annual General Meeting . We will be based out of Queen’s University’s Bioscience Complex and our field trips will take us to a variety of natural spaces in the beautiful Kingston area. description: Stuck on the bus: Toronto's 2024 budget offers no relief for Scarborough’s weary commuters Jan 13, 2024 Residents and transit advocates see the lack of busway funding as the latest example of how the area has been neglected by politicians at city hall and Queen’s Park. Successive administrations have spent decades playing political ping-pong with the replacement for the aging RT — at one point it was going to be an LRT — ultimately leaving Scarborough residents today without rapid transit for years. “Sometimes it feels like the city views Scarborough residents’ time as less valuable," said Krissan Veerasingam, board member for transit advocacy group TTCriders.
